cards.title: 制针的例子说明分工把产量提高到几百倍

sentences.text: To take an example, therefore, from a very trifling manufacture, but one in which the division of labour has been very often taken notice of, the trade of a pin-maker:
sentences.quote: To take an example, therefore, from a very trifling manufacture, but one in which the division of labour has been very often taken notice of, the trade of a pin-maker:

sentences.text: 一个人一天做不出二十枚针，十个人分工后一天能做四万八千枚以上：例子把抽象的「分工提高生产力」变成了能数的数字。
制针业是斯密有意挑的「很不起眼的制造业」：工序全在一个作坊里，分工一眼就看得见。
